title: Drug Dosing Assay Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Define assay parameters
steps.instruction: Perform a drug dosing assay in triplicate for up to three cell lines and three replicate plates.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the provided fields above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol files and unzip them if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: Upload your custom labware to the OT App via More > Custom Labware > Add Labware, selecting the .json labware files as required.

steps.title: Upload .py protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the .py protocol file to the OT App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App; consult support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press Run to start the protocol.
